description: Rigid placement of the worm BAG-1 ULD model into the BAG1 site of 9HEU and contact analysis with RPN-1
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
cif=S.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/9HEU.cif",timeout=300).text
lines=cif.split("\n"); i=0
while not lines[i].startswith("_atom_site."): i+=1
hdr=[]
while lines[i].startswith("_atom_site."): hdr.append(lines[i].strip().split(".")[1]); i+=1
rows=[]
while not lines[i].startswith("#"):
    p=lines[i].split()
    if len(p)==len(hdr): rows.append(p)
    i+=1
c={h:k for k,h in enumerate(hdr)}
ch=np.array([r[c["auth_asym_id"]] for r in rows]); resi=np.array([int(r[c["auth_seq_id"]]) for r in rows])
resn=np.array([r[c["auth_comp_id"]] for r in rows]); atn=np.array([r[c["auth_atom_id"]] for r in rows])
xyz=np.array([[float(r[c["Cartn_x"]]),float(r[c["Cartn_y"]]),float(r[c["Cartn_z"]])] for r in rows])
OFF=115
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
bag=ch=="x"; rpn=ch=="f"
hCA={int(r)+OFF:x for r,x,a in zip(resi[bag],xyz[bag],atn[bag]) if a=="CA"}
hAA={int(r)+OFF:AA3.get(n,'X') for r,n in zip(resi[bag],resn[bag])}
RPN=xyz[rpn]; RPNres=resi[rpn]; RPNresn=resn[rpn]
wtxt=S.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-O44739-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text
W={}
for l in wtxt.split("\n"):
    if not l.startswith("ATOM") or l[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
    ri=int(l[22:26])
    if not (1<=ri<=95): continue
    an=l[12:16].strip(); e=(l[76:78].strip() or an[0])
    if e=="H": continue
    d=W.setdefault(ri,{"aa":AA3[l[17:20].strip()],"at":[]})
    x=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
    d["at"].append((an,e,x))
    if an=="CA": d["CA"]=x
W={k:v for k,v in sorted(W.items()) if "CA" in v}
def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc,Qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); H=(P-Pc).T@(Q-Qc); U,s,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    dd=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,dd])@U.T; return R,Qc-R@Pc
def dpm(score,gap=-0.6):
    n,m=score.shape; F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    for a in range(1,n+1):
        for b in range(1,m+1):
            u=F[a-1,b-1]+score[a-1,b-1]; v=F[a-1,b]+gap; w=F[a,b-1]+gap
            if u>=v and u>=w: F[a,b]=u;P[a,b]=0
            elif v>=w: F[a,b]=v;P[a,b]=1
            else: F[a,b]=w;P[a,b]=2
    a,b=n,m; al=[]
    while a>0 and b>0:
        k=P[a,b]
        if k==0: al.append((a-1,b-1)); a-=1; b-=1
        elif k==1: a-=1
        else: b-=1
    return al[::-1]
hids=sorted(hCA); A=np.array([hCA[k] for k in hids])
wids=sorted(W); Bc=np.array([W[k]["CA"] for k in wids])
d0=max(0.5,1.24*(min(len(A),len(Bc))-15)**(1/3)-1.8)
def refine(al,it=25):
    for _ in range(it):
        P=np.array([A[a] for a,b in al]); Q=np.array([Bc[b] for a,b in al])
        R,t=kabsch(Q,P); Bt=(R@Bc.T).T+t
        new=dpm(1/(1+(np.linalg.norm(A[:,None]-Bt[None],axis=2)/d0)**2))
        if new==al: break
        al=new
    P=np.array([A[a] for a,b in al]); Q=np.array([Bc[b] for a,b in al])
    R,t=kabsch(Q,P); Bt=(R@Bc.T).T+t
    D=np.linalg.norm(A[:,None]-Bt[None],axis=2)
    return al,R,t,sum(1/(1+(D[a,b]/d0)**2) for a,b in al)/len(A)
best=(-1,None)
for Lf in (min(len(A),len(Bc)), min(len(A),len(Bc))//2):
    for off in range(-len(Bc)+Lf,len(A)-Lf+1,4):
        ia=max(0,off); ib=max(0,-off); ln=min(len(A)-ia,len(Bc)-ib,Lf)
        if ln<6: continue
        al,R,t,tm=refine([(ia+k,ib+k) for k in range(ln)],4)
        if tm>best[0]: best=(tm,al)
al,R,t,tm=refine(best[1],25)
rms=float(np.sqrt(np.mean([np.linalg.norm(A[a]-(R@Bc[b]+t))**2 for a,b in al])))
print(f"worm BAG-1 ULD model superposed on the BAG1 chain of 9HEU: aligned {len(al)}/85, TM={tm:.3f}, Calpha RMSD={rms:.2f} A")
w2h={wids[b]:hids[a] for a,b in al}
print("worm->human equivalences at the patch:", {k:f"{hAA[v]}{v}" for k,v in sorted(w2h.items()) if v in (151,189,191,192,195,196,216,218,219,220)})
wq={ri:[(an,e,R@x+t) for an,e,x in d["at"]] for ri,d in W.items()}
out=[]
for ri in sorted(wq):
    mind=1e9; partners=set()
    for an,e,x in wq[ri]:
        dd=np.linalg.norm(RPN-x,axis=1); k=int(np.argmin(dd))
        if dd[k]<mind: mind=float(dd[k])
        for q in np.where(dd<4.5)[0]: partners.add(f"{AA3.get(RPNresn[q],'X')}{RPNres[q]}")
    if mind<8.0:
        out.append(dict(worm=f"{W[ri]['aa']}{ri}", human_equiv=(f"{hAA[w2h[ri]]}{w2h[ri]}" if ri in w2h else "-"),
                        min_dist=round(mind,2), n_RPN1_partners=len(partners), partners=";".join(sorted(partners)[:6])))
df=pd.DataFrame(out)
print("\n=== rigid placement of the worm BAG-1 ULD into the BAG1 site of 9HEU ===")
print(df.to_string(index=False))
nclash=sum(1 for r in out if r["min_dist"]<2.2)
ncont=sum(1 for r in out if r["n_RPN1_partners"]>0)
print(f"\nheavy-atom clashes <2.2 A: {nclash};  worm residues contacting RPN-1 (<4.5 A): {ncont}")
print("contacting worm residues:", [r["worm"] for r in out if r["n_RPN1_partners"]>0])
df.to_csv("/tmp/worm_dock.csv",index=False)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4))
ds=[r["min_dist"] for r in out]; labs=[f"{r['worm']}\n({r['human_equiv']})" for r in out]
cols=["#E45756" if d<2.2 else ("#54A24B" if d<4.5 else "#BBBBBB") for d in ds]
ax.bar(range(len(out)),ds,color=cols)
ax.axhline(4.5,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1); ax.axhline(2.2,ls=":",c="#E45756",lw=1)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(out))); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,rotation=90,fontsize=6)
ax.set_ylabel(r"min heavy-atom distance to RPN-1 ($\AA$)")
ax.set_title("C. elegans BAG-1 ubiquitin-like domain model rigidly placed in the BAG1 site of cryo-EM 9HEU\n"
             "green, contact (<4.5 A); grey, no contact; dotted line marks a clash threshold of 2.2 A")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
